strings.(글래스턴 중앙광장의 명물, 세이렌 분수대 앞. 주민들은 물론이고, 다른: (At the Siren Fountain, a famous sight in Glaston's central plaza, residents and apparent visitors from other regions admire the fountain.)
strings.(한 사람이 분수 안에 동전을 던지고 소원을 빌자, 그걸 본 다른 사람이: (Someone throws a coin into the fountain and makes a wish. Another person sees this and follows suit, as though spellbound.)
Please let me meet someone nice this year...
I hope my mother stays healthy...
Please let me earn lots of Ely...
strings.(사람들의 소중한 마음이 담긴 동전들이 물속에서 햇빛을 받아 아름답게 반: (Coins carrying people's heartfelt wishes sparkle beautifully in the sunlight beneath the water.)
It's beautiful. I should make a wish too.
strings.(그런 그때, 마치 금이라도 삼킨 것처럼 번쩍거리는 장신구를 착용한 남자: (Just then, a man wearing accessories so dazzling he looks as though he has swallowed gold appears before the Siren Fountain.)
strings.(그러자 소원을 빌고 있던 사람들이 익숙한 듯이 뒤로 물러난다.): (The people making wishes step back, as though accustomed to this.)
strings.당신들, 소원 빌러 왔지? 세이렌에게 줄 돈은 내가 낼 테니까, 소원만: You're all here to make wishes, right? I'll pay the Siren, so just make your wishes. Don't waste your own money. All right? Hahaha!
strings.(라슈르가 광장에 있는 새들에게 모이를 주는 것처럼 금화 주머니 안에서: (Lashur takes gold coins from his pouch and tosses them one by one into the fountain, as though feeding birds in the plaza.)
strings.(그때마다 사람들이 소원을 빌고, 라슈르에게 고맙다는 말을 전한다.): (Each time, people make wishes and thank Lashur.)
Hello, Lashur. It's been a while since we met in Lifthrasir.
Oh, it's you. Here, make a wish.
strings.어떤 소원을 빌어야 할지 선택하지 못하는 것 같네? 그러면 고민되는 거: Can't decide what to wish for? Then wish for everything that's on your mind.
strings.금화 하나에 소원 하나라면 네 소원엔 금화가 몇 개 필요한 거지?: If one gold coin buys one wish, how many coins do your wishes need?
strings.(라슈르가 금화주머니를 거꾸로 들어 분수 안에 모두 쏟아버린다.): (Lashur turns his coin pouch upside down and empties it into the fountain.)
strings.네 상황이 어떤지 나야 잘 모르겠고, 관심도 없지만 다 잘될 거야. 나: I don't know what your situation is, and I don't particularly care, but it'll all work out. I, Lashur, am wishing for you, after all.
strings.걱정해주시는 건 고맙지만, 너무 쓰시는 거 아닌가요?: Thank you for your concern, but aren't you spending too much?
Hahaha, money? It's always here today, here tomorrow.
Who knows? I've never been without it. Hahaha. Anyway, don't underestimate yourself. You're someone extraordinary.
strings.얼마 전부터 다른 대륙에서 온 영웅이 빈민가 라슈에트를 방문할 거라고 소: A little while ago, rumors began spreading that a hero from another continent would visit the slums of LaChouette.
strings.라슈에트가 빈민가에요? 제가 글래스턴에 온 건 오늘…. 아니, 그보다 제: LaChouette is a slum? I only arrived in Glaston today... Wait, more to the point, hardly anyone should know I was coming.
Rumors in Glaston are like smoke. People create them out of nothing, spread them everywhere, and they seep into everyone's lives...
strings.리치베리에 은근히 많은 정보가 모여드는데, 그중 네가 마음에 들어 할 것: A surprising amount of information finds its way to Richberry. Some of it might interest you. What do you say?
Share a little of what you have with me, and I might tell you.
I hear mysterious fragments are occasionally found in places that strong people like you visit. I don't need many. Just twenty.
strings.컬렉션으로만 두고, 다른 곳에 쓰진 않을 테니까 너무 걱정하지 말고. 하: They're only for my collection. I won't use them for anything else, so don't worry. Hahaha.
strings.(…일단 정보가 필요하긴 하니까 전달해 보자….): (...I do need information. I'll bring him the fragments...)
strings.(라슈르가 %s에게서 받은 파편을 살펴보더니 가볍게 미소 짓는다.): (Lashur examines the fragments he received from %s and gives a small smile.)
strings.이게 그 소문의 파편이군. 희귀하긴 하지만, 내가 이걸로 뭘 할 수는 없: So these are the famous fragments. Rare, certainly, but I doubt I can do anything with them. They'll have to serve as collector's pieces.
I collect rare stones and things. I've grown tired of collecting gold nuggets.
strings.내게도 질린 표정을 짓다니. 하하하. 그러면 약속대로 괜찮은 정보를 주지: Now you look tired of me too. Hahaha. Then, as promised, here's some worthwhile information.
strings.개국 공신 가문인 디아몬트 가(家)의 가주가 오늘도 라슈에트에 갔다. 이: The head of House Diamont, a family honored for helping found the nation, visited LaChouette again today. That should do, yes?
strings.전혀 모르겠다는 표정이네? 귀족 나으리가 빈민가에 갔다는 게 네게는 큰일: You look completely lost. I suppose a noble lord visiting the slums doesn't strike you as a big deal.
strings.의회와 관련 있는 귀족들은 웬만하면 하층민과 관련된 일을 하지 않아. 빈: Nobles connected to the council usually avoid anything involving the lower classes. Appearing in the slums is extremely unusual.
Well, members of the imperial family or His Majesty might visit occasionally.
strings.그런 귀족 나으리께서 빈민가를 찾았다면 나쁜 것이든 좋은 것이든 일이 있: If a noble lord like that comes to the slums, something must be happening, whether good or bad.
Understand now? That's why I called it worthwhile information. Hahaha.
strings.개인적으로 살짝 궁금하긴 하지만, 깊게 관여하고 싶진 않아. 귀족이랑 엮: I'm a little curious myself, but I don't want to get deeply involved. What good ever comes of entangling yourself with nobles?
It seems more useful to someone like you, with connections all over the place, than to me.
Hahaha. I'll leave it to you to decide what to do with this information.
I've rewarded you generously, just as I promised before. See you later, my friend.
strings.(라슈르가 %s의 어깨를 툭툭 두드리고는 어디론가 사라진다.): (Lashur pats %s on the shoulder and disappears somewhere.)
...He really is an unusual person... I should go back to LaChouette Street for now.
Huh. Where have I heard the name Diamont before...?
strings.(빈민가라 불리는 라슈에트의 한적한 골목, 거리와는 어울리지 않는 분위기: (In a quiet alley in LaChouette, known as the slums, a middle-aged man whose bearing seems out of place stands looking down the alley.)
strings.(다들 그가 누군지 아는 듯, 고개를 숙여 인사하고 서둘러 지나친다.): (Everyone seems to recognize him. They bow in greeting and hurry past.)
strings.(라슈르 씨가 말한 사람이 저 사람….): (That must be the person Lashur mentioned...)
strings.(그 순간, 중년 남자와 %s의 눈이 마주친다. 남자가 손을 들어 자신에: (At that moment, the middle-aged man's eyes meet %s's. He raises a hand and beckons.)
Don't pretend you didn't notice. You were watching me.
strings.(남성이 %s의 모습을 훑어보고는 조심스레 입을 연다.): (The man looks %s over and speaks cautiously.)
...Judging by your appearance, I know who you are.
strings.글래스턴은 소문에 민감한 곳이지. 그런 소문의 중심에 있는 사람을 몰라본: Glaston is sensitive to rumors. It would be absurd not to recognize the person at the center of them.
strings.자네는 이스트랜드를 악의 위협에서 구한 영웅…. %s…. 그러나 의회에선: You are the hero who saved Eastland from the threat of evil... %s... An important figure whom the council, however, finds rather hard to like.
I'd like to know who you are as well.
My introduction is overdue. I am Manuel, head of House Diamont.
I do not know what brings you to Glaston, but pass through quietly.
strings.제가 하려는 일이 뭔지 알고, 그렇게 말씀하시는 거죠? 일단 절 좋게 보: Do you know what I intend to do, to say that? I can at least tell you don't think highly of me...
strings.그보다 여기 계시는 이유를 알고 싶습니다. 무슨 일을 하시려고 하는지 여: More to the point, I would like to know why you are here. I hear you come here almost every day. What are you trying to do?
Hush. There are many ears around. So you have investigated that much...
strings.흠…. 내게 이야기를 듣고 싶다면…. 자네, 혹시 젠틀맨 알고 있나?: Hmm... If you want to hear my story... Do you happen to know Gentleman?
strings.(에우가몬 극장에서 본 것 같은 인형 이름이 젠틀맨이었던 것 같은데….): (I think the doll I saw at the Eugamon Theater was called Gentleman...)
strings.자네가 알고 있는 젠틀맨에 관한 걸 가져오게. 그러면 내가 여기 있는 이: Bring me anything you know about Gentleman. Then I will tell you why I am here.
strings.탐정 K의 사건 기록, 종이 장미, 과녁…. 모두 증거로 채택되지 않았: Detective K's case records, a paper rose, a target... All materials that were not admitted as evidence. I will not ask where you found them.
Once, there was a man who called himself Mr. Demonic.
strings.어, 바로 말씀해 주시는 건가요?: Oh, you're telling me right away?
You have shown your sincerity. I am simply answering.
strings.오래 전, 나와 비슷한 위치에 있던 친구가 있었네. 유약한 성격이었지만,: Long ago, I had a friend in a position similar to mine. He was timid, but he dreamed of the theater and was always writing plays.
strings.그러나 그의 아버지가 세상을 떠나면서 그가 원하는 건 아무것도 할 수 없: But after his father passed away, he could no longer do anything he wished.
strings.반강제적으로 가주 자리를 맡게 되면서 엄청나게 스트레스를 받았었던 것 같: He was practically forced to become head of his house, and it seems the strain was immense. At the time, all I wanted was to help my friend.
strings.우연인지 몰라도, 한 마법사가 귀족들 고민 상담을 해준다는 이야기를 듣게: Perhaps it was coincidence, but I heard of a mage who offered counsel to troubled nobles. So I recommended that he consult the mage...
Sigh... It is my responsibility. He changed after meeting that mage...
strings.아직도 그의 말이 기억나. 제대로 된 힘만 있다면 원하는 걸 할 수 있다: I still remember his words. With the right power, he could do whatever he wished.
I did not understand what he meant at first, but his later actions made it clear.
strings.그가 밤마다 거리에서 사람을 해쳤다는 걸…. 글래스턴을 공포로 떨게 한: That he was attacking people in the streets every night... That he had become [Gentleman], the murderer who terrorized Glaston...
strings.어느 비 오던 밤. 마지막이라면서 그가 내게 인사를 하고 떠났지. 그가: One rainy night, he said it would be the last time, bid me farewell, and left. Afterward, an order of knights pursued him as far as LaChouette...
strings.그도, 기사단도 어떻게 됐는지는 알 수 없네. 모두 흔적도 없이 사라졌거: I do not know what became of him or the knights. They all vanished without a trace. The tale became a ghost story, and decades passed.
strings.최근들어 이곳을 찾으셨다면 이유가 있으시겠죠?: If you've started visiting this place recently, there must be a reason.
strings.라슈에트에서 그와 비슷한 인상착의를 지닌 자가 나타났다는 이야기가 들려왔: I heard that someone matching his description had appeared in LaChouette.
strings.소문은 진실이 아니면 점점 커지는 법. 그래서 직접 확인하러 왔지만, 아: When rumors are untrue, they tend to grow. So I came to see for myself, but I learned nothing.
strings.기사단에게 맡기면 되는 일이지 않나요?: Couldn't you leave that to the knights?
strings.그냥 내가 마음의 짐을 덜기 위해서…, 천인공노할 범죄자를 붙잡는 단서라: Perhaps I simply want to ease the burden on my heart... To find even a clue that might help catch a monstrous criminal...
strings.뭔가 더 필요한 것 같군. 하지만, 이야기할 수 없는 것들도 있으니 지금: You seem to want something more. But there are things I cannot discuss, so we will stop here for now.
And I offer my thanks for helping my son.
Have I met your son, Manuel? Oh, Alexis...
The fool who sold our family's land and fled to Invernel is my son.
But I haven't done anything to help Alexis...
If you helped the Order in Highland, that also means you helped my son...
strings.(그 일이 글래스턴 사람의 귀에도 들어가다니….): (Even people in Glaston have heard about that...)
Did my son happen to mention me? That I am assisting the council...
strings.어쨌든 이번 대화는 여기서 끝내지. 다른 사람에게도 함구해 줬으면 좋겠군: In any case, this conversation ends here. I would appreciate your keeping it from others.
strings.(이번…? 나중에 뭔가 더 이야기를 할 것 같은 느낌이 드는데….): (This conversation...? I get the feeling he'll have more to say later...)
strings.(일단 광장으로 돌아가자. 라슈르가 있다면 좀 더 이야기해 보고….): (Let's return to the plaza for now. If Lashur is there, I'll try talking to him some more...)
strings.(광장에 돌아온 %s의 시야에 또 금화 주머니를 들고 분수대에 뿌리는 라: (Returning to the plaza, %s spots Lashur once again holding a pouch of gold coins and scattering them into the fountain.)
strings.라슈르 씨, 광장과 주민을 위해 기부해 주시는 건 좋습니다만!! 이런 식: Lashur, donations for the plaza and its residents are welcome, but performances like this cause problems!!
strings.관리원들이 모두 나와서 수거해가도 힘들다고요!!: Even with every maintenance worker out here, collecting them is hard work!!
Hahahaha! When I asked last time, you said it was allowed.
strings.이 정도 양일 줄 몰랐기 때문입니다!: We didn't know you meant this many!
All right. I'll think of another way, then.
When will we ever finish carrying this away? I'd better call everyone from the office...
strings.(라슈르가 떠나는 모란의 등을 두들겨 주다 뒤쪽에서 자신을 바라보는 시선: (Lashur pats Moran on the back as he leaves, then notices someone watching him from behind.)
strings.너로군. 정보는 좀 쓸만했어?: It's you. Was the information any use?
That sounds like you're saying I need to gather some more information.
Did I hit the mark? Hahaha.
strings.혹시 다른 정보 같은 게 없을까요?: Do you happen to have any other information?
strings.(라슈르가 가볍게 웃으며 %s의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Lashur chuckles and pats %s on the shoulder.)
strings.정보란 건 말이지. 때와 장소, 그리고 대상에 따라 다르거든. 지금은 그: Information depends on the time, the place, and the person. This doesn't seem to be the right moment.
I see. It can't be helped.
I like how quickly you accept things.
Then I'll see you later. I'm rather busy.
strings.(라슈르가 떠나고 난 후, 모란이 같이 일하는 사람들과 함께 분수대 앞에: (After Lashur leaves, Moran appears at the fountain with his coworkers.)
The gold coins Lashur scattered alone must be worth about ten billion Ely...
strings.(라슈르 씨는 다시 생각해봐도 참 특이하단 말이지.): (However I look at it, Lashur really is an unusual person.)
strings.(그건 그렇고 중요한 정보를 얻었으니 정리가 필요하겠군.): (Anyway, I've learned something important. I should sort through it.)
